question: Among the patients with normal anti-SM, how many of them does not have thrombosis?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "anti_sm_thrombosis" AS SELECT CAST(t2.id AS BIGINT) AS patient_id, t2.sm AS anti_sm_result_raw, t1.thrombosis AS thrombosis_status_code FROM table_2 t2 INNER JOIN table_1 t1 ON CAST(t1.id AS BIGINT) = CAST(t2.id AS BIGINT)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH normed AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(anti_sm_result_raw, ''))) AS sm_norm,
    thrombosis_status_code
  FROM anti_sm_thrombosis
), per_patient AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN sm_norm IN ('0','negative','neg','(-)','陰性','阴性') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal,
    MAX(thrombosis_status_code) AS thrombosis_code
  FROM normed
  GROUP BY 1
), final AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS patients_with_normal_anti_sm_no_thrombosis
  FROM per_patient
  WHERE has_normal = 1 AND COALESCE(thrombosis_code, 0) = 0
)
SELECT
  patients_with_normal_anti_sm_no_thrombosis,
  'Normal anti-SM defined as one of: 0, negative, neg, (-), 陰性, 阴性; thrombosis=0 treated as no thrombosis.' AS assumption
FROM final;
